items.text:
Fast Food Ads vs. Reality 🍔🎥

Think that pizza, ice cream, and beer in ads look too good to be true? You’re absolutely right. Here’s how fast food companies deceive you:

Pizza Ads

🧀 They use nuts, bolts, and artificial glue to make pizzas look extra cheesy and delicious.
Ice Cream Ads

🍦 It’s not ice cream—it’s mashed potatoes mixed with water and coloring to stay picture-perfect under hot lights.
Beer Ads

🍺 That thick foam? It’s soap. Real beer foam disappears too quickly for a photo shoot.
What other tricks have you spotted in food ads? Share below! ⬇️

#FoodMarketing #AdVsReality #MarketingTricks #FoodStyling #FastFoodAds #BehindTheScenes #FoodPhotography
